title: Handley Page Halifax LK930
memorial_details: Upright, rectangular, rough-hewn stone with brass plaque. Dedication is incised with white-painted, capital letters. Stone is surrounded by white kerbstones and granite chippings. Around 2020 a second plaque (possibly laminated plastic) mounted on a post was added, commemorating civilians involved in rescue attempts in the burning aircraft. The dedication is in black capital letters on a white background.
inscription: IN RECOGNITION OF/ THE 7 MAN CREW OF HALIFAX/ (LK930) NO 1664 HCU SQUADRON/ DISHFORTH/ WHICH CRASHED AT THIS POINT/ ON 22 MARCH 1944/ WITH THE LOSS OF 3 LIVES
